# Use motion to clarify an action

Identify the change that the user needs to notice. Choose a transition that shows the relationship
between the starting state and the result. If the state is already clear, leave it still. Use the
existing motion system for interruption and sequencing. Check that rapid repeat actions settle
into the correct state, and stop nonessential loops when hidden.

With reduced motion enabled, preserve feedback through a direct state change or another
low-motion treatment. Verify a representative interaction at normal speed and with reduced
motion. Where browser capture is available, review the actual transition and its final state.
